title: Zeus Juice Bar Liq Fizzy Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Zeus Juice Bar Liq Fizzy Cherry offers a playful twist on a traditional fruit flavour, combining the deep sweetness of red Cherry with a sparkling textural element. The ripe Cherry notes provide a juicy and rich base, while a fizzy sherbet effect on the exhale adds a layer of excitement and complexity. The double-concentrated formula ensures that the fruit and fizz elements are perfectly balanced and intensely flavourful. Mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is optimised for use with low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, such as pod vape kits and pen-style starter devices. The use of nicotine salts ensures a smooth throat hit and efficient nicotine satisfaction, even at higher strengths. For the best performance and flavour delivery, it is recommended to pair this e-liquid with coils or pods ranging between 0.6ohm and 1.2ohm. Bar Liq by the renowned UK manufacturer Zeus Juice is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Bar Liq provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
